# UCnet discovery fixtures

`pages.json` contains the heading and primary content excerpts from nine public
UCnet pages fetched on 2026-09-28. Each key is its source URL. Navigation outside
the page content was omitted. Headings on eight pages were reconstructed from
their rendered text; the MR contract heading retains its original markup.

The fixtures cover SV and RP contracts on separate tabs, the direct K3 local
agreement, CM's unpublished first agreement, and MR's `contract-mr` page whose
final document is not posted yet. They contain PDF links, not the PDF files.
Tests construct a small main listing and sitemap around these excerpts.
